bull_bear.body:
- Gross debt as of June 30, 2026 stood at INR 58.8 Cr (Long-Term Debt INR 33.4 Cr) versus INR 60.8 Cr (Long-Term Debt INR 33.1 Cr) as of 31st March 2026; the historical chart shows gross debt 93.6 / 81.6 / 68.3 / 60.8 for FY23-FY26 labelled -35.0%, with interest cost 17.7 / 15.3 / 11.0 / 8.7.
- Holds 15.12% in NOCIL Ltd, described in the deck as 'part of promoter holding'; the ROCE footnote separately states ROCE 'is for FY26 excludes dividend income and investment in NOCIL Ltd'.
- Return on Capital Employed is shown as 27.1% / 32.5% / 21.0% / 23.0% across FY23-FY26 (excluding dividend income and investment of NOCIL and after exceptional item), and Return on Equity as 6.1% / 12.1% / 14.9% / 11.8%.
- Capital allocation intent is framed only qualitatively - 'execution excellence and operational discipline to deliver sustainable value creation for all our stakeholders'; the deck states no dividend, buyback or payout policy.
bull_bear.title: Capital allocation policy (investor deck)

business.body:
- Describes itself as a 'Leading integrated uniforms solution provider with end-to-end capabilities across design, sourcing, manufacturing and distribution', serving institutions across education, healthcare, aviation, security, automobiles, QSRs, petrochemicals, oil & gas and the public sector.
- Model is stated as 'Asset-light hybrid manufacturing model supported by an established vendor ecosystem' and a 'Scalable business model focused on institutional and B2B growth', with a branding & distribution led, demand-driven character.
- Strategic framework splits 2019-2025 ('Laying the Foundation for Growth & Diversification' - navigating significant financial challenges, adopting an asset-light model, entering Digital Infrastructure) from '2026 and Beyond' ('Building the Next Chapter of Growth').
- Diversification is framed as 'a response to the institutional demand patterns driven by government spending on education, healthcare, digital infrastructure and public welfare'.
business.title: Positioning (investor deck)

business.body:
- [Tax] In accordance with Ind AS 12, the Company recognized a Deferred Tax Assets (net) charge of Rs. 5.0 Cr under tax expense during the period.
- [Leadership] The deck flags a 'Recalibrated management team' - Mr. Priyavrata Mafatlal as MD and CEO (18+ years) and Mrs. Smita Jhanwar as CFO (17+ years) - alongside promoter Chairman Mr. Hrishikesh Mafatlal (49+ years), who is also Chairman and Promoter Director of NOCIL Ltd.
- [Subsidiaries] Two named vehicles carry the growth agenda: Pieflowtech Solutions Private Limited (Digital Infrastructure software/applications) and Mafatlal Apparel Exports (apparel manufacturing and exports).
business.title: Notable from the deck

deepdive.thesis: The deck positions Mafatlal Industries as a 120+ year old legacy textile house 'Transformed from Legacy Textile Player to Diversified Integrated Uniform and other Solutions Provider', running an asset-light, vendor-ecosystem-backed model across Textiles & Related Products, Digital Infrastructure and Consumer Durables aimed at institutional and B2B demand.
